question: give top 1 marketing channel by expenditure and then top 1 customer name for least revenue and then top 1 product with most orders
sql:
SELECT channel, SUM(amount_spent) AS total_expenditure
FROM marketing_spend
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY total_expenditure DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: give top 1 marketing channel by expenditure and then top 1 customer name for least revenue and then top 1 product with most orders
sql:
SELECT c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: give top 1 marketing channel by expenditure and then top 1 customer name for least revenue and then top 1 product with most orders
sql:
SELECT p.id, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: give top 1 marketing channel by expenditure and then top 1 customer name for least revenue and then top 1 product with most orders
sql:
SELECT channel
FROM marketing_spend
WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2026-12-31'
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY SUM(amount_spent) DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: give top 1 marketing channel by expenditure and then top 1 customer name for least revenue and then top 1 product with most orders
sql:
SELECT c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2026-12-31'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) ASC
LIMIT 1;

question: give top 1 marketing channel by expenditure and then top 1 customer name for least revenue and then top 1 product with most orders
sql:
SELECT p.name
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2026-12-31'
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
